name: Ether Sprite Swarm
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

generalAbilities.name: Natural Glow
generalAbilities.description: An ether sprite sheds light as a torch. The sprite can suppress this glow by spending a single action with the concentrate trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rowdy Clamor
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. The sprite swarm creates a din by laughing, taunting, and insulting nearby creatures. Creatures in the area are Deafened.

offensiveAbilities.name: Luminous Pattern
offensiveAbilities.description: The sprites glow brightly, flying in a shifting pattern of light. All creatures within 20 feet become Dazzled for 1 minute (DC 16 Will Saving Throw negates).

offensiveAbilities.name: Spark Bombardment
offensiveAbilities.description: The sprites hurl luminous sparks at a creature within 20 feet dealing 5d4 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Steal
offensiveAbilities.description: The sprites rummage through the possessions of a single creature within its space, attempting a thievery|defense:reflex check against the creature's Reflex DC. On a success, the sprites take one item of negligible or light bulk that the creature is carrying but not holding or readied. On a critical success, the item can be one that is held or readied, such as a weapon or potion

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Needles
offensiveAbilities.description: The sprites numerous rapiers deal 2d6 Piercing Damage damage to each enemy in the swarm's space (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save).
